answers.answer: AB = AC (tangent segments) and MB = MC (radii), so line AM is the axis of BC, hence $AM \perp BC$ and $m(\angle BXM)=90^\circ$. Y is the midpoint of chord BD, so $MY \perp BD$ and $m(\angle BYM)=90^\circ$. The opposite angles X and Y of XBYM sum to $180^\circ$, so XBYM is cyclic.

35°. In the cyclic quadrilateral XBYM, $m(\angle XBM)=m(\angle XYM)=35^\circ$ (both subtend XM). Since $AB \perp MB$, $m(\angle ABX)=90^\circ-35^\circ=55^\circ$. In right triangle ABX, $m(\angle A)=90^\circ-55^\circ=35^\circ$.
